method: A glyph chain with no language behind it, fitted on the public training pages only. Each word is written glyph by glyph: the next glyph is drawn given the two before it in the word (counts of glyph trigrams inside words, with word start and word end as symbols), and the first glyph of a word is drawn given the last glyph of the word just written (counts of last-glyph, first-glyph pairs of adjacent words on a line). The first word of each ten-word row is drawn from the line-initial distribution. No word list, no word order, no meaning. 13,000 words; seed 42, taken because the text from seed 41 contained one four-word run that also occurs in the manuscript and was refused by the copy guard. No other selection. The same procedure landed on F-002 (R-002).
